verses.english:
The wise neither befriend nor dispute
Those who are savagely cruel.
Examine and abandon both
Animosity and intimacy.
verses.chinese:
智者不宜和粗鲁的人,
亲密接触或争论是非,
与其结怨或过于亲近,
都会带来不幸的结局。

verses.english:
Relying on people of excellence,
Asking questions of the wise,
And befriending those of good character:
Whoever does this is always happy.
verses.chinese:
虔诚地依靠高尚者,
诚恳地请教饱学者,
忠诚地交结厚道者,
均能成就一生的平安。

verses.english:
Whatever is said at awkward times
Is held in disdain by all.
Is it not inferred that someone is mad
From the fact that they talk too much?
verses.chinese:
说些不合时宜的话,
会带来众人的蔑视;
喋喋不休的言谈者,
按逻辑就是个疯子。

verses.english:
Modest people presume that everything
They have to say could be mistaken.
Thinking this way, they say little;
Such people get more respect than others.
verses.chinese:
有些身单力薄的人们,
担心话说多了会出错;
如果懂得这点不多言,
就会受到人们的尊敬。

verses.english:
When the time and place are appropriate,
Focus your thoughts and speak sparingly.
Even good advice, when given to excess,
Loses its value like unsold merchandise.
verses.chinese:
如果是在适当的场合,
就应该谨慎地说些话;
就是格言说得太多了,
也像剩货一样难推销。

verses.english:
To see one's faults as faults
Is very hard, even for the wise.
When many say that one has defects,
It shows what they say may be true.
verses.chinese:
尽管是个博学多闻的人,
也很难认识自己的过失,
很多人对我谈及此事后,
就会思考自己有无过失。

verses.english:
To know one's faults but not to shed them
Means one is possessed by demons;
And those who fail to remedy their faults
Cannot be considered human.
verses.chinese:
明知有过失却不改者,
肯定就被魔鬼缠了身;
如果照常我素我行者,
就不必把他当人看待。

verses.english:
Even those of limited intelligence
Should analyze their faults and eliminate them.
By implementing the antidotes in this way
They increasingly enhance themselves.
verses.chinese:
稍微有点头脑的人,
担心过失会害自己;
这种能自我反省者,
自然就能步步高升。

verses.english:
Others may be intelligent or compassionate,
Heed advice or be courageous;
Even if one cannot do these things,
One should emulate each one of them.
verses.chinese:
聪明的人和仁慈的人,
随和的人和勇敢的人,
尽管不懂其他的事情,
也能自行其力保平安。

verses.english:
One may have long associated with boorish people,
But happiness comes when they are abandoned.
"One may have a fine tooth," the elders say,
"But if it is always loose, extracting it brings happiness."
verses.chinese:
和坏人的交往虽然很久,
能断绝关系是最佳法则;
摇动的牙齿虽然很好看,
将它拔掉是普世的共识。

verses.english:
Pests who always hang around and irritate others
Should be given a little something and sent away.
A finger that has been bitten by a snake
Will take one's life if it cannot be amputated.
verses.chinese:
对经常抱怨的下属,
给点好处就要打发;
被毒蛇咬下的伤口,
不忍切除就难保命。

verses.english:
Upon achieving a position of importance,
Avoid stinginess and give others small gifts.
When one has become ruler of the land,
Why be greedy for material things?
verses.chinese:
如果获得了至高位置,
就不必吝啬钱财之物;
如有治国安民的权力,
更不必吝啬施舍宝物。

verses.english:
If the wise desire to accumulate wealth,
The best way to guard it to give some away.
If one wants to increase the flow from a well,
It is advised to draw off some water.
verses.chinese:
如果智者想要积累财富,
只要能够施舍失财复得;
如果想让井水经常充盈,
只有汲取才是正道法门。

verses.english:
Whosoever desires worldly affluence
Must be engaged in many endeavors.
But if petty distractions are seen to bring misery,
Then abandon aspirations for prosperity.
verses.chinese:
如果要想圆满幸福,
平时就要手脚勤快,
若把忙碌视为苦根,
就得放弃幸福圆满。

verses.english:
No matter what task you set out to accomplish,
Consider both its advantages and disadvantages.
If a task should be avoided when they are equal,
What need be said when disadvantages prevail?
verses.chinese:
无论要干什么样的事,
首先必须考虑其利弊,
利弊相当也应该放弃,
坚决放弃弊多利少者。

对耿直的学者要亲近,
对狡诈的学者要留心,
是老实的庸人要仁慈,
是滑头的庸人必抛弃。

verses.english:
Even though one may lack wealth and attendants,
With intelligent friends one achieves one's goals.
If this is the case even for animals,
Needless to say it is so for humans.
verses.chinese:
尽管没有钱财和仆从,
有聪慧的朋友能做事;
即使畜生也能帮点忙,
何况是万物之灵的人。

让人去做力所能及的事,
不要逼做力所不及的事;
马车不能在水面上走动,
船舶也不能在陆上航行。

verses.english:
Even if old spiteful foes are friendly,
One must never mingle with them.
Even if water is at full boil,
Does it not douse fire on contact?
verses.chinese:
和结有深仇大恨的敌人,
虽然有些来往也戒密切;
虽然是高温滚沸的开水,
遇到火焰时仍将其熄灭。

verses.english:
Responsible people with a sense of shame,
Can be relied on even if enemies.
Someone once sought refuge from a dependable foe
Who gave protection even at risk to his own life.
verses.chinese:
只要真诚且能知羞耻,
虽是敌人也可以信任;
因拯救了真诚的敌人,
同样也能会以恩相报。

verses.english:
Although one may have no evil intentions,
One should not trust just anybody.
Although deer are always good-hearted,
Carnivores regard them as food.
verses.chinese:
对自称没有坏心眼的人,
不要过于信任并为依靠;
异禽怪兽虽然也有良心,
会把其他动物当作食物。

verses.english:
When fools go down the wrong path,
One can presume they really are fools;
But when the wise take that path,
One should look for some other reason.
verses.chinese:
如果是愚者走上邪路,
就可以把他当作傻瓜;
如果是智者走上邪路,
就应该追究其中原因。

verses.english:
The wise live in a land of plenty,
Where charity is lacking, but no robbery exists;
In a land of poverty, there may be no robbery,
But one may be ruined by crafty borrowing.
verses.chinese:
智者能够很好地使用钱财,
尽管不会施舍也绝不抢劫,
应该离开钱财挥霍的地方,
不被抢光也会被债务剥光。

verses.english:
One may know quite well how to do things alone,
But all tasks should be done through consultation.
Those who fail to collaborate with others
Buy expensive regret for themselves.
verses.chinese:
尽管自己博学广闻,
办理事情还要商议,
凡事不愿与人商量,
就是拿钱买来懊悔。

verses.english:
When having delicate discussions,
Speak not to third parties, even if friendly.
Evil friends performing vetala rituals
Will be the first ones to be devoured.
verses.chinese:
如果讨论沮丧的事情,
再亲密也莫超过三人,
如修炼还生用了恶伴,
首先会把同炼者吃掉。

verses.english:
Knowing how to obtain things, giving impartially with skill,
Being subdued, having consideration for others' feelings,
Being grateful for those who quell one's fears:
If one aspires to these qualities one achieves the world.
verses.chinese:
知道取舍并平等待人,
和蔼可亲更尊重别人,
无所畏惧也受恩不忘,
这种人能够得到一切。

verses.english:
When enemies come seeking refuge,
Honor them and speak pleasantly.
Elders of the past say a crow
Gained happiness by relying on a mouse.
verses.chinese:
假若敌人前来归降,
就应供养并要赞美;
若乌鸦依靠了老鼠,
才获得平安和幸福。

verses.english:
The wise do not involve themselves with
Bad friends and bad learning,
Bad thoughts and bad actions;
If they did, they would be just like fools..
verses.chinese:
交恶友并听信谗言,
爱干坏事并持邪见;
智者自会远离此行,
如果孤行定是笨蛋。

verses.english:
Regarding action taken after careful analysis,
How could things possibly turn out poorly?
For those with good vision who watch where they're going,
How could they ever walk off a cliff?
verses.chinese:
如果是仔细研究后的行动,
就不可能出现失败的结局;
如果智者睁开双眼走大路,
就不可能会堕入万丈深渊。

verses.english:
When one trains in good qualities that improve
Both oneself and others, it is a sign of wisdom.
But certain knowledge, like archery,
Is destructive to one's family lineage.
verses.chinese:
学会利人利己的学问,
才能显示智者的本色;
但是有些知识像射手,
如果会了就要灭家族。

verses.english:
If one want to achieve stature for oneself,
One must only do that which helps others.
Do not those who want to clean their faces
Need first to wipe the mirror clean?
verses.chinese:
想要使自己获得高位,
首先必须得学会利人;
想把自己修饰的好看,
首先必须把镜子擦亮。

verses.english:
Those who want to completely subdue another
Must work hard to develop their own good qualities.
See how those who want to kill a foe
Achieve their goal though force of arms.
verses.chinese:
如果想把对方征服,
首先必须练好本领;
如果要想杀死敌人,
首先必须练好刀枪。

verses.english:
Since swindlers use deceit in their words,
The honest must check them out carefully.
Having once been misled, what then is the use
Of self-promotion, saying, "I'm honest!"
verses.chinese:
狡诈者善于表现温顺,
诚实者需要特别留心;
若受骗后自称老实人,
这样的自夸没有用处。

verses.english:
It is said in the accounts of ancient times,
"What is needed when dealing with others is:
Deceit with the deceitful, honesty with the honest,
Stability [with the stable, and instability] with the unstable.
verses.chinese:
对付狡猾者就要狡猾,
对待诚实者需要诚实,
对待动摇者必须坚定,
这是来自前人的遗训。

verses.english:
It is always good when the wise are kindly,
Even to those who are enemies.
It may not promote true reconciliation,
But it is a sure cure for malice.
verses.chinese:
智者对待自己的敌人,
时常也要像亲友一样,
尽管不会有利于和解,
却是消除怨恨的良药。

verses.english:
Because it is hopeless in this world
To achieve one's aims with bad language,
Though one may have private ambitions,
Speak agreeably with everyone.
verses.chinese:
如果只会用恶言恶语,
不可能完成任何事情;
尽管心中也有些私利,
说话需要和别人随和。

verses.english:
When working on behalf of oneself and others,
Rough and gentle means both are valid.
But the Buddha did not teach deceptiveness,
As a practice of skillful means.
verses.chinese:
为自己和他人办成事,
软硬办法均可以使用,
多巧善变的办事方法,
佛祖并未说成是奸诈。

verses.english:
The wise place their trust in counsel that is
Temporarily unpleasant, but ultimately helpful.
They teach good qualities to an only child
By voicing disapproval and imposing discipline.
verses.chinese:
为了履行长远计谋,
智者会忍暂时痛苦,
学者即使年迈多病,
也把知识传给后人。

verses.english:
When one's wealth grows to excess
One's downfall is close at hand.
A pond completely full of water
Overflows, or even fails.
verses.chinese:
如果过分积累财富,
很快就会走向衰败;
被流水灌满的池塘,
不会决堤就会冲光。

verses.english:
Some are unsuited to engage in deeds
That are beneficial to others.
Usually garlic helps nervous tension,
But for bile ailments is poisonous.
verses.chinese:
对一些人有利的事情,
另一些人不应该去做;
蒜头医治风寒有疗效,
却对患胆病者是毒素。

verses.english:
Though the weak must always be cared for,
The great fear decline if they befriend them.
When melted butter is put in a container,
Do mice not come and gnaw on it?
verses.chinese:
对于经常扶持弱者的人,
伟人也生被衰败的疑心;
就如把酥油放在容器中,
老鼠也会把它啃坏一样。

verses.english:
Those who depend on bad people
Are themselves harmed by their bad influence.
When fish depend on flowing canal water,
Notice how they get scattered over the field.
verses.chinese:
如果仅仅依靠坏人,
因其恶习会害自身,
如依赖渠水的鱼儿,
会摊晒在田野一样。

verses.english:
When unreliable pests are about to lean on you
Give them a little something and send them away.
When an unlucky sign appears to a family,
Some resources should be earmarked to counter its effect.
verses.chinese:
如果是坏人前来依靠,
就要给点东西打发掉;
如果家中出现了恶兆,
就应该花点钱来解恶。

verses.english:
Though noble people may have gone elsewhere,
They are respected and close relationships maintained.
If one always worships wish-fulfilling jewels,
Good fortune prevails and one's work gets done.
verses.chinese:
圣哲尽管到了他乡,
照样会被尊重供养;
正如时时虔敬珍宝,
就能如意吉祥一样。

verses.english:
When coarse people are overly praised,
They later scorn those who praised them so.
When filth is tossed up into the air,
It falls back down on the tosser's head.
verses.chinese:
过分表扬下贱的人,
他会反过来诽谤你;
若往天上抛掷脏物,
定会落到抛者头顶。

verses.english:
When wise people are humiliated,
The fault will rebound on the abusers themselves.
When torches are held upside down,
The hands of the brandishers are burned.
verses.chinese:
如果是辱骂智者,
自己也跟着遭殃,
如把火把倒着拿,
会烧伤自己的手。

verses.english:
There is a place for everything, and
Everything should be kept in its place.
Crown ornaments should not be placed on the feet,
Nor foot ornaments on the crown of the head.
verses.chinese:
本身属于什么材料,
就应放在什么地方,
首饰不能戴在脚上,
脚镯不能顶在头上。

verses.english:
When undertaking important tasks,
One must firmly rely on good friends.
When setting a fire to burn a great forest,
The wind must decidedly be one's aide.
verses.chinese:
做伟大事业的时候,
必定需要依靠好友;
用火烧尽大森林时,
必定需要依靠大风。

verses.english:
Pleasant words filled with kindness are the best way of
Achieving things easily, attracting others, and pleasing them.
Who can satisfy others simply with riches?
Sacrificing life and limb will not please even half of them.
verses.chinese:
仁者会说普遍的事,
简易的事情易吸人;
若是喜欢钱财的人,
搭上性命也难满意。

verses.english:
Though impoverished, do not be depressed;
Though wealthy, do not be gleefully proud.
Since the effects of karma last a very long time,
Various pains and pleasures are yet to come.
verses.chinese:
不要因穷困太伤感,
也不因富有太傲慢,
命运的里程很遥远,
各种苦乐仍会出现。

verses.english:
Extending devotion to other teachers
While the protector of beings, the Buddha, lives,
Is like digging a brackish well near a river
Of water with the eight good qualities.
verses.chinese:
普世佛祖在世的时候,
却要去礼拜外道祖师,
正如水源充足的地方,
去挖一口苦水井一样。

verses.english:
When one is familiar with any kind of task,
There is no difficulty at all in doing it.
The sublime Dharma can be mastered as easily
As one trains to practice the technical crafts.
verses.chinese:
无论要做什么事情,
习惯了不会有困难;
正如学习手艺一样,
修法也并不很困难。

verses.english:
Those who are content with just a few things
Will never know the depletion of wealth.
Upon those who are dissatisfied, looking for more,
A continuous rain of misery falls.
verses.chinese:
如果能够以少知足,
财富就能享用不尽;
追求财富不知满足,
痛苦就像雨水连绵。

verses.english:
The Buddha taught that the wealth one gets
Should be given away when needed.
Accumulated wealth is like honey -
One day it will be used by others.
verses.chinese:
佛说遂愿获取的钱财,
必要时就要学会施舍;
积累的钱财如同蜂蜜,
会有一天被别人享用。

verses.english:
In this world there is no certainty
The loans that one has made will be repaid.
But just a little charity given to beggars
Brings a hundredfold results effortlessly.

Since it is impossible for the miserly to become rich
Or the generous to become poor,
It is as if misers have no interest in wealth
And generous people are greedy.
verses.chinese:
吝啬鬼不会成富翁,
施舍者不会成穷人,
吝啬鬼好像不爱财,
施舍者倒像贪财人。

verses.english:
Fearing generosity will impoverish them,
The miserly are incapable of charity.
Knowing greed will surely impoverish them,
The intelligent donate whatever they have.
verses.chinese:
害怕布施就会变穷,
吝啬鬼不愿意布施;
吝啬鬼肯定会变穷,
智者有钱就会布施。

verses.english:
Since assets do not increase if left sitting idle,
Merchants distribute their wares for sale.
The wise, like merchants, distribute their wealth
Since they will not get rich if it is stashed away.
verses.chinese:
积压货物不能够赚钱,
所有商人到处摆货摊;
光靠积攒不会变富贵,
智者总是到处施舍钱。

verses.english:
It is said by the very learned that
Those who possess countless treasures
Yet give not a thing to anyone
Are truly the impoverished of this world.
verses.chinese:
虽然拥有无数珍宝,
不愿意施舍半文钱;
据广闻博学的人说,
没有比他更穷的人。

verses.english:
Fearing their descendants may become destitute,
The small-minded hoard even trivial things.
In order for heirs to gain high status,
The wise help out others, as if bribing them.
verses.chinese:
愚人担心家世衰退,
凡是钱财都要积累,
智者为了后代兴旺,
发工钱一样去布施。

verses.english:
Thinking to make their descendants wealthy,
Some sacrifice themselves to enrich their children.
But then the little brats fight with their parents,
Squandering their wealth and roaming like dogs.
verses.chinese:
若为子孙后代兴旺,
便卖自身留给儿郎,
可是逆子违背父愿,
耗尽钱财似狗游荡。

verses.english:
Children lack the kindness for parents
That their parents have given to them.
Children are cared for so long by their parents,
Then parents age and their children mistreat them.
verses.chinese:
不管父母对子女怎样慈爱,
子女不会对父母同样相待;
父母竭尽心力去爱护子女,
父母老了却受子女的虐待。

verses.english:
Some of the wealthy hoard their money,
While others give charity where needed.
For those two types and their descendants,
Future lifetimes will be quite different.
verses.chinese:
积累钱财的吝啬鬼,
积累钱财的乐施者,
他们本人及其后人,
来世会有明显区别。

verses.english:
Those who are enslaved by their attachments
Pursue wealth with no regard for their lives.
But when the contented obtain some wealth,
They calmly give it away to others.
verses.chinese:
成为轮回之奴的众生,
只会拼命为钱财忙碌;
知足者得到了钱财后,
心安理得地施给别人。

verses.english:
Some perfect generosity by giving away their possessions;
Their patience increases if that makes others angry,
And they feel joyous when others are satisfied.
Theirs is the supreme practice of generosity.
verses.chinese:
放弃获得就是施财,
对他发怒他能忍受,
别人满意他才高兴,
施舍确是修法之本。

verses.english:
Usually the body is like an enemy,
An ocean-like receptacle of suffering.
But when the wise know how to put it to use
It rightfully serves as a support for merit.
verses.chinese:
身体是苦海的深渊,
它好像和敌人一样;
聪明人只要会支配,
也可以成为造福源。

verses.english:
Although one's life can be destroyed in an instant,
Predispositions of virtue carry forward a long time.
The aroma of sandalwood borne by the wind
Spreads far and wide, inducing pleasure.
verses.chinese:
对刹那间失去的生命,
如有善业会流传百世;
如风中荡漾的檀香味,
传到远方也令人兴奋。

verses.english:
There is immense suffering at being separated
From the happiness one has long enjoyed.
Those who insist their body is permanent
Are devastated when, powerlessly, they must die.
verses.chinese:
长期共同享受幸福的人,
如果离开了必定会痛苦;
因为人人不能摆脱死亡,
今世的一切应该全抛弃。

verses.english:
Surrounded by all of one's friends and family,
Frightened, voice quivering, and vision failing,
There is no way to know where one is headed,
At such times phony virtue proves destructive.
verses.chinese:
亲友全部都围在周围,
气息奄奄的双目无光,
不知死亡后归向何方,
此刻欲善都就有用场。

verses.english:
The maladies of rebirth in miserable realms
Must be prevented before they occur.
Like a lightening bolt that strikes one's head,
What can be done once it has hit?
verses.chinese:
对于三种恶趣的恶兆,
未出现之前就要提防;
不然就如同晴天霹雳,
落到头上就无可奈何。

verses.english:
While people know definitely they will die,
Severed from all friends and family,
Still they peacefully go to sleep;
What can possibly be in their minds!
verses.chinese:
明知将会诀别亲友,
同时自己非死不可,
然而却能酣然入睡,
是什么在心中作祟。

verses.english:
One may not be able to be diligent,
But at least do not fall to the lower realms.
Heroes might not slay their enemies,
But do they ever kill their allies?
verses.chinese:
个人即使不能奋进,
绝不应该堕入恶趣,
英雄虽然不能杀敌,
绝不会杀害自己人。

verses.english:
Even during temporary discomfort,
The wise cultivate lasting happiness.
Curing disease by burning and bloodletting
Is the tradition of skillful physicians.
verses.chinese:
智者为了长远的幸福,
暂时苦点也会求学问;
用针灸和刀石除疾病,
出自高明医生的经典。

verses.english:
When one cannot tolerate
The good fortune of others,
One's own good fortune is destroyed,
Thus, one is just aiming envy at oneself.
verses.chinese:
如果别人幸福美满,
自己就会心情不舒;
正如毁掉自身福泽,
就要自我嫉妒一样。

verses.english:
If one wants to destroy foes because they give harm,
One needs only destroy one's own anger.
In cyclic existence, since time immemorial,
Our anger has given us endless trouble.
verses.chinese:
要想消除敌人的危害,
只有克制自己的怨恨,
使怨恨自有轮回以来,
就苦害过无数的众生。

verses.english:
Though one may desire to destroy every enemy,
How could they all be abolished by killing?
Simply by conquering one's own anger
One simultaneously slays all enemies.
verses.chinese:
若想消灭所有的敌人,
仅仅靠杀戮不会消灭,
若是克制了自身愤怒,
就能消灭了一切敌人。

verses.english:
If one gets angry at the rash but mighty,
It is oneself who is especially harmed.
Whatever could there be to make one angry
At fine people who are totally at peace?
verses.chinese:
本领高强而狂暴者,
愤怒特别对己有害;
高尚而有和气的人,
没有使他愤怒之事。

verses.english:
Grass leaves growing from a single stalk
Are strewn everywhere by the wind;
Those born together in a single family
Are parted from each other by karma.
verses.chinese:
同一条根上长出的草,
很容易就会被风吹散,
正如同时出生的众生,
会有个个不同的命运。

verses.english:
We cling to those who were once strangers;
After that, they again go elsewhere.
Why do we and they get connected?
They die, and then we grieve over them.
verses.chinese:
虽然昔不相识今亲密,
短暂相聚后各奔前程,
此人不管有多么亲近,
死后肯定会痛苦难消。

verses.english:
If one strongly wants to achieve private aims,
One must first work for the interests of others.
By working solely for personal concerns,
It will be impossible to achieve them.
verses.chinese:
如想办成个人的事,
首先应该为别人想,
只会为自己谋算者,
肯定办不成自己事。

verses.english:
Those who work mainly for the welfare of others
Are like clever people furthering their own interests;
But those who work only for their own interests
Are like honest people working to help others get ahead.
verses.chinese:
如果只为利他为重,
倒像是骗子行私利;
只有以利己为重者,
倒像是个老实的人。

verses.english:
Even when the wise work for goals of this life,
They succeed by doing so following the Dharma.
See the difference in wealth and good fortune
Between good people and ordinary thieves.
verses.chinese:
智者虽然在此生修行,
若修成佛法方得安乐;
对于圣人和盗贼来说,
幸福圆满间大有区别。

verses.english:
One half of the short human life span
Is spent sleeping at night as if dead,
And the other half lacks joy
Due to ills of sickness and aging.
verses.chinese:
人们在短暂人生的一半,
像死一样的睡眠中度过,
同样疾病和衰老的痛苦,
另一半也不能享受幸福。

verses.english:
When one actually sees the Lord of Death,
Who is sitting right next to everybody,
One cannot remember to finish eating,
To say nothing of doing other tasks.
verses.chinese:
人们若能真正想到,
伴随在身旁的死神,
不要说干别的事情,
就连食欲不会旺盛。

verses.english:
The Lord of Death does not sit waiting,
Nor ask, "Have you finished your work yet?"
So if you have things that must be done,
Begin immediately.
verses.chinese:
不管你是否做完事情,
死神绝不会让你多停,
如果还有该做的事情,
现在就应该努力去做。

verses.english:
Though choked with tears, and pleading,
"I haven't finished what I am doing!
Could you please wait for a little while today?"
How can the Lord of Death's mind be changed?
verses.chinese:
我还有没有做完的事,
请你慈悲地再等一天,
不管多么悲痛地请求,
死神从不会缓延时辰。

verses.english:
Shun the hectic life and be happy;
If impossible, mix with good people.
Why bother rearing a deadly snake?
If you must, take care to recite spells.
verses.chinese:
舍弃纷扰方能安乐,
不然就要结交好友;
饲养毒蛇没有用处,
要养就要勤诵咒语。

verses.english:
When the mind is in a state of distraction,
Practicing the sublime Dharma is hopeless.
But when the mind is completely pacified,
It is very close to being serviceable.
verses.chinese:
如果时常心神不定,
虽修佛法难成正果;
如果时常心物所思,
不会离正果太遥远。

verses.english:
One greatly skilled with all meditative objects,
Mentally subdued through meditative stabilization,
And well trained in the exalted Dharma
Is a vast field of all good qualities.
verses.chinese:
能够精通所想的事情,
并能用禅定来敛己心,
再能用心来学习佛法,
就有功德圆满的基础。

verses.english:
Fools are astounded by those who study,
But the wise are amazed by those who do not.
Therefore, even when the wise get elderly
They continue learning to aid future lives.
verses.chinese:
愚人总以学习为耻,
学者却以不学为耻,
学者虽然年事已高,
还为来生积累知识。

verses.english:
Apparently, since fools lack wisdom,
They have failed to learn anything useful!
Examining themselves and seeing their ignorance
Should prompt them to study especially hard.
verses.chinese:
愚人以无才能为理由,
作为不学知识的借口;
其实正因为没有才能,
愚人更应该努力学习。

verses.english:
Having seen that one is a fool in this life
Due to neglect of study in previous lives,
Fearing birth as a fool in future lives,
One studies hard in this life, even if difficult.
verses.chinese:
只因前世没有学习,
今世就转生为愚人,
若怕来世仍旧愚蠢,
今生再难也得学习。

verses.english:
Fools with very limited intelligence say,
"If one meditates, there is no need to study."
Without study, mere meditation, even if assiduous,
Is the way animals achieve things.
verses.chinese:
坐禅不需要广听闻者,
是不求甚解者的说法,
不闻佛典却只会坐禅,
乃是畜生修法的途径。

verses.english:
The reliability of the law of cause and effect
Is the special instruction of the Omniscient One.
If one can become omniscient without studying,
How can the law of cause and effect be true?
verses.chinese:
因果循环的绝对性,
就是佛法根本精神,
不去学习能成全知,
哪有这种因果正理。

verses.english:
Meditating without first studying may temporarily
Bring achievements, but these quickly vanish.
Even if gold and silver are thoroughly melted,
When heat is removed they harden again.
verses.chinese:
不闻佛典光靠坐禅,
暂时成功也会褪色;
金银虽然能够炼熔,
一旦离火就会变硬。

verses.english:
Meditation is the discarding of faults and their causes
Through the use of wisdom to analyze the profound.
Meditation alone may achieve something for awhile,
But like washing the unclean body, the results do not last.
verses.chinese:
依靠智力去自我反省,
抛弃过失就和禅有缘;
恰似洗去身上的污垢,
时常不重洗又会染身。

verses.english:
If causes and effects are incomplete in any way,
Selflessness may be realized, but not Buddhahood.
Those unpracticed in supreme methods
Are foe destroyers who only see the truth [of selflessness].
verses.chinese:
殊胜因缘尚未俱全,
虽懂无我也难成佛;
如果不用妙计修炼,
虽见真谛并非罗汉。

verses.english:
Therefore, having comprehended well all phenomena
And placed one's mind in meditative stabilization,
All faults and their predispositions are eradicated
And one becomes a fully completed Buddha.
verses.chinese:
能够正确领悟佛法,
禅定就会印入心中,
完全抛弃一切过失,
肯定能够欣然成佛。

verses.english:
If one lacks intelligence, how could one grasp
The treatises, even though they are excellent?
How could cattle appreciate golden jewelry
Inset with gems, even though it is lovely?
verses.chinese:
如果没有高深的智慧,
经典再好也不会学好;
镶嵌着宝石的金服饰,
再美也不被牛犊理会。

verses.english:
If the wise fail to put into practice
The meaning of all good advice they've received,
Yet all along know it to be quite true,
What use is their knowledge of the treatises?
verses.chinese:
智者把一切格言,
当作真理来领悟,
只懂道理不实践,
学会经典没有用。

verses.english:
Each day one should take to heart a few words
Of the scriptural advice that one needs;
Before very long one will become wise,
Just as ant hills are built or honey is made.
verses.chinese:
自己所需要的经典,
只要每天记住一句,
如蜂酿蜜及蚁做窝,
不久就可以成圣哲。

verses.english:
When there arises desire to behave wrongly,
Quell the impulse, whatever the cost.
Bear every hardship, even at risk of life,
To safeguard the mind as scriptures prescribe.
verses.chinese:
如果愿意修行菩萨行,
无论如何也要听佛言,
任何时候都能坚持住,
需要舍命也要护佛法。

verses.english:
If by such effort one can practice antidotes
Exactly as the scriptures advise,
Because the wise do not tell falsehoods
One will see the benefits later!
verses.chinese:
若能根据经典教义,
以相生相克去修行;
若是智者不用说谎,
功效以后自会分明。

verses.english:
Note how such practitioners of the past have flourished,
And practitioners of today as well.
By means of this excellent rationale,
Those in the future will also prosper.
verses.chinese:
从前依格言者兴旺,
现在见到的也如此;
美好格言永远同效,
它能使后来人美满。

verses.english:
Even if the intelligent are learned in their own systems,
They study with interest the textual systems of the wise.
Even if a precious gem is very fine,
Until it is cut and polished, it is worth little.
verses.chinese:
尽管智者通晓一切,
也能潜心学习经典;
尽管珍宝蕴藏财富,
未售之前并不起眼。

verses.english:
Even though there are many forests,
The special places where sandalwood grows are few.
Likewise, although there are many scholars,
Those who explain things well are very hard to find.
verses.chinese:
尽管很多地方有森林,
缺少生长檀香的森林;
尽管很多地方有学者,
缺少能讲格言的学者。

verses.english:
A good horse is known when ridden,
Gold or silver are known when melted,
An elephant is known in battle, and
Scholars are known when they write good advice.
verses.chinese:
在远路上辨出好马,
在冶炼中辨出金银,
在战场上辨出勇悍,
在著书时能辨智者。

verses.english:
Those who want to be recognized
As exemplars by all in the world
Should investigate this treatise well
And strive to develop antidotes.
verses.chinese:
如果为整个世人,
想做理性的标准,
就要研读这本书,
对症下药勤修行。

verses.english:
Those who know how to perform worldly tasks well
Are adept in the ways of sublime Dharma.
Therefore the practice of the ways of Dharma
Is the way of life of the bodhisattvas.
verses.chinese:
要想知道世间事,
就必须修行正法,
修身炼性行佛法,
乃是菩萨解脱行。
